subject: Training data pipeline for perception model
text:
Hi Johannes,

We recently onboarded Mytra who was moving from simulation to real-world data collection to train their perception model. At the time they lacked a system to effectively index, auto-label and QA to keep up with the surging training data volume. I wonder if those are the challenges you've encountered at Pixel Robotics? 

In case Encord is new to you - we help physical AI teams (e.g. Fox Robotics, Zipline, Mytra, etc.) automate their annotation pipelines as they scale. Handful of customers in the space leverage our model-assisted workflow and our labelling editor's support across 2D (image & video) and 3D point cloud data, as a complement to Foxglove.

Keen to hear how you're thinking about your training data as you scale? I'm flexible Tuesdays to Thursdays if you're open to chat. 

Best,
Winnie
